Op de dag van de verhuizing is het goed: On moving day, it is good to have a schedule, agreed with the removal team. Make sure you know exactly what time the removal team will arrive, and agree with your friends/family who does what. This means everyone can keep working smoothly, and miscommunication is avoided. Also important: make sure there is enough food and drink throughout the day, both for yourself and for your helpers!
